criteria.name: Requested ledger structure
criteria.description: Returns a compact ledger with the six named tests, formulas or formula references, numeric values, pass/fail states, and a final computed label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the response has most required fields but omits one test, formula, or pass/fail state.

criteria.name: Rainfall and temperature calculations
criteria.description: Correctly computes 15-day precipitation as 100.2 mm, 5-day precipitation as 72.2 mm, event-day share as 0.089, cross-source wetness ratio as 0.747, and near-freezing values from 0.91 C ERA5 Tmax mean and -0.2 to 1.6 C local daily range.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for mostly correct precipitation or temperature values with minor rounding or one missing source.

criteria.name: Extent, surface-change, and exposure calculations
criteria.description: Correctly computes the 21.0 ha flow area, 30.0 ha total affected area, S1/S2 magnitude ratio 1.845, S1/annual ratio 6.996, and compact exposure counts of 100 total, 50 amenity, and 50 highway features.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-4 points for correct values in two of the three groups or for small rounding differences.

criteria.name: Threshold decisions
criteria.description: Applies the stated thresholds so wet context, near-freezing state, reported extent, short-window surface dominance, and local exposure pass while event-day rainfall dominance fails.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points if the final states are mostly right but one threshold is inverted or omitted.

criteria.name: Rejected alternative
criteria.description: Rejects event-day rainfall dominance using the computed event-day share and the fact that the event day was not the local 15-day precipitation maximum.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for rejecting rainfall dominance with only one of the two required numeric reasons.

criteria.name: Concise interpretation
criteria.description: States the computed label only as the consequence of the numeric ledger, not as a broad narrative.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points if the label is correct but surrounded by unnecessary explanatory prose.

criteria.name: Overclaim control
criteria.description: Keeps broad population context separate from observed local losses and does not state that rainfall is proven as the dominant trigger.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points if only one of the two scope limits is handled correctly.
